document.title: R. STAHL Steckvorrichtungen SolConeX & CES - Reihe 8575 selection table and technical data (manufacturer catalogue, distributor mirror)
document.pages: E3/2 exact 8575/13-200 selection row and 3P contact diagram 06199E00; E3/9 interlocked switch and ratings; E3/12 optional supporting-terminal block 151307

modelingNotes: Exact order identity is directly verified in the R. STAHL manufacturer catalogue 2010-06-EK00-III-de, E3/2: 8575/13-200 is the CES 16 A extra-low-voltage wall socket, 3P, 20-25 V, 50/60 Hz, violet, with no auxiliary coding nose. No successor or different suffix is substituted.

The operating instructions for 8575/13 and 8575/14, IDENT-Nr. 85 756 18 30 0 / R. STAHL / 05.01, printed page 5 (right side of physical PDF page 5), show L1, L2 and L3 in extra-low-voltage 3P figure Z0299 and explicitly state that extra-low-voltage connectors have no protective-earth contact. Manufacturer source: https://r-stahl.com/fileadmin/tx_aimeos/Files/1_/00/0000000000000008575618300_001_00/Betriebsanleitung_8575618300_001_00.pdf

The matching 3P figure is 06199E00 in catalogue E3/2 and the supplied 2007 manual, printed page 5 / physical page 7. The base nose is at 6h; 8575/13-200 has no auxiliary nose. Only the L1/L2/L3 identities are modeled: no numeric pin renaming, rear-view coordinates or installed phase assignment is inferred.

C.L1/C.L2/C.L3 are functional cable-side pole endpoints; C is an authoring side alias, not a stamped marking. Exact cable-clamp legends and individual screw positions remain unverified. M.L1/M.L2/M.L3 expose the corresponding mating-contact identities. C/M distinguish sides rather than manufacturer terminal numbers.

The 05.01 manual printed page 2 permits switch-on only with an inserted R. STAHL 8575/12 plug. Catalogue E3/9 explicitly specifies a three-pole interlocking switch with forcibly opening contacts. Three ganged contact functions represent the poles; open is the OFF drawing reference, not a claim about an unactuated mechanism or a simulated state. There are no fixed links across the switched C/M paths. Only explicit wires, jumpers and terminated cores join nets.

The exact coded operating band is 20-25 V AC at 50/60 Hz, with rated current 16 A. Catalogue E3/9 gives the extra-low-voltage family capability maximum of 50 V and AC-3 switching capacity 50 V, 16 A; the 05.01 manual printed page 3 gives insulation voltage 60 V and conductor capacity max 4 mm2 / max 2 Nm torque. No nominal_voltage scalar is assigned: this engine compares nominal values exactly, so neither the 50 V family maximum nor an arbitrary value within the 20-25 V range represents the type correctly.

Ratings depend on document and hardware revision. The 05.01 manual printed page 3 states IP54 and 12 A at frequencies >=100 Hz; catalogue E3/9 also states IP54. The supplied 2007 manual printed page 4 instead states IP66 / IP55 mated and gives no frequency derating. These revisions corroborate the ELV contact inventory and interlock, not identical environmental ratings. The 20-25 V / 50-60 Hz coded variant is the scope of this model; installed nameplate, temperature class and enclosure rating still require review.

Catalogue E3/12 lists optional supporting-terminal block 151307 for 8575/13, with two supporting terminals for 2 x 4 mm2 each. It is not included in this base socket model; whether it is installed is unverified. No unsupported accessory terminals, neutral, shield, signal, communication or bonding screw are added. Mating suitability, conductor selection and installed optional equipment require application review.

connectionCoverage.notes: Three cable-side functional endpoints (C.L1/C.L2/C.L3) and three mating contacts (M.L1/M.L2/M.L3) are inventoried as ganged switched poles. Manufacturer figures Z0299 (05.01 manual) and 06199E00 (2007 manual/catalogue) establish L1/L2/L3 and no protective-earth contact for this extra-low-voltage insert. Exact cable-clamp legends and screw positions remain unverified; C/M are authoring aliases. Optional supporting-terminal block 151307 is outside this model and its installed presence is unverified. No universally required individual contact or installed accessory connection is inferred.
